integrity_statement: The theorem is supported by an explicit symbolic proof and a reproducible independent finite verifier; no independent formal or expert validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Bounds are established for at most five binary runs and all query intervals; no assertion that unrestricted binary words attain the universal four-SUPS maximum. The exhaustive verifier is finite and not an infinite proof. Historical originality is assessed only against inspected accessible literature.
title: A sharp five-run threshold for three shortest unique palindromic substrings
